title:
Identifies the vertex in a fully analyzed {@link PkgInference} {@link FlowGraph} representing the
{@link Transform#target}  in a Data Integration pipeline and replaces that vertex with an instance of
{@link PkgInference.Vertex.SourceTarget} or {@link PkgInference.Vertex.Transform} target, depending on whether the
replaced vertex was a {@link PkgInference.Vertex.Source} or {@link PkgInference.Vertex.Target}, respectively.
